children: (the “Company”), today announced that its Board of Directors has approved a one-for-ten (1-for-10) reverse stock split of the Company’s outstanding common stock. The reverse split is expected to become effective at 12:01 a.m. Eastern Time on November 6, 2026. The Company’s common stock has been assigned a new CUSIP number, 68237Q500, in connection with the reverse stock split.

Following the reverse split, every ten (10) shares of Onconetix common stock will be automatically exchanged into one share of common stock. The Company’s common stock will continue to trade on Nasdaq under the symbol “ONCO”.

The reverse split will reduce the number of outstanding shares of common stock from approximately 5,886,774 shares outstanding as of October 21, 2026 to approximately 588,677 shares, before giving effect to adjustments resulting from the treatment of fractional shares. The reverse stock split will not change the number of authorized shares of common stock, which will remain at 250,000,000 shares, or the par value of the Company’s common stock, which will remain at $0.00001 per share. No fractional shares will be issued in connection with the reverse split. Stockholders who would otherwise be entitled to receive fractional shares will instead receive cash payments in lieu of such fractional shares.

The reverse stock split will be effected simultaneously for all outstanding shares of the Company’s common stock and will affect all of the Company’s stockholders uniformly. The reverse stock split will not affect any stockholder’s percentage ownership interest in the Company, except to the extent that a stockholder would otherwise be entitled to receive a fractional share for which cash will be paid in lieu thereof. The reverse stock split will not affect the par value of the Company’s common stock and will also not affect the number of authorized shares or par value of our preferred stock. The rights and privileges of the holders of the common stock will be unaffected by the reverse stock split. Proportionate adjustments will be made, as applicable and in accordance with their respective terms, to the exercise or conversion prices and the number of shares issuable under the Company’s outstanding options, warrants, convertible securities and equity incentive plans.

is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on the research, development, and commercialization of innovative oncology solutions.
